reasoning.description: One or two sentences. While gathering: what you have, what is missing, and what to do next. When stopping: what was gathered and anything the user asked for that is missing; this is passed to the report writer.

agents.description: Agents to run in this round. Empty when stop is true.

goal.description: What this agent should retrieve or answer. Never mention PDFs, files or email.

stop.description: True when enough data has been gathered. The final report is written automatically after you stop.
